title: RetrievalChunk
description: One indexed passage of a record a person may read, for per-account grounding (ADR-0049): the document at orgs/{org}/chunks/{id} without its vector. The stored document also holds `embedding`, a Firestore vector of `dimensions` floats made by the `embed` role's `embed_profile`; JSON readers (erasure, export, tests) never see it. Written by code only, from records already stored and screened clean (RT-01, RT-08). `owner` is the person whose record it is; `team_id` is set only for a source a team may read under the existing rules (a team pin, or a deliverable of a world while a team share is in force), and team reads are re-checked at every query (RT-02, RT-03). A chunk lives no longer than its source (RT-07). $defs `prompt_block` is the data block a prompt receives and `grounding_ref` what an answer shows it looked at. Rules RT-01 to RT-10 are in retrieval_chunk.rules.md.

chunk_id.description: ch_ and the first 32 hex digits of SHA-256 over org, source kind, source id, source version, position and embed_profile, so indexing the same version again writes the same ids.

source.description: The record the passage came from. deliverable and upload name an artifact version (ADR-0018); minutes name the meeting and the version of its minutes artifact; pin and memory_item name the record, whose current text is indexed (version null).

label.description: What the person sees for the source (a file or deliverable label, a meeting or pin title, or 'Your note'): one line of 1 to 120 characters with no control, format, line or paragraph separator character.

text.description: The passage: 1 to 1200 characters, cleaned and secret-redacted by code before it is embedded or stored (RT-08). Line breaks and tabs stay; every other control character, format character and line or paragraph separator is gone. Untrusted data, never instructions.

prompt_chunk.description: One retrieved passage as a prompt sees it.

prompt_block.description: The data block tilo-api renders into the user turn (never the system prompt, EFF-04) of the person's own Quick ask and their own signed-in intake's Director brief extraction (RT-04): at most 5 passages that passed the query-time scope check, nearest first. Fenced and labelled as untrusted data.

grounding_ref.description: What an answer shows it looked at, one per passage given to the model (RT-04): the source and its label, never the text. A Quick answer carries at most 5 as `grounded_on`.
